clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in me 
by section 49b (2) of the Organic Act of 
Puerto Rico, as amended by section 6 
of the Act of August 5, 1947, Public Law 
362, 80th Congress, it is hereby ordered 
that the District Court of the United ,  
States for Puerto Rico and the Depart­
ment of Justice shall be exempt from 
making the reports to the Coordinator 
of Federal Agencies in Puerto Rico which, 
are provided for in such section.
